result.title: VidDub: Replacement-Aware Distillation for Two-Step Video Dubbing
result.summary: Video dubbing aims to synthesize lip movements that match target speech while preserving the speaker identity, head pose, and background of a source video. Existing editors are predominantly trained via self-reconstruction under original paired audio, even though the source mouth becomes a conflicting target when driving speech is replaced. We introduce replacement-aware cross-audio supervision: paired-audio samples use full-frame reconstruction, whereas unpaired replacement-audio samples mask out source-mouth reconstruction losses and supervise the mouth solely through audio-visual synchronization while preserving unmasked facial regions and background. Because offline dubbing provides the complete source video and target speech beforehand, we present VidDub, a full-context diffusion editor distilled into two denoising steps (2 NFE). Our replacement-aware teacher first learns accurate lip synchronization without regressing toward conflicting source mouth movements. Matched trajectory regression then transfers the teacher's CFG-guided trajectories to a two-step student, and distribution matching distillation recovers visual quality after step compression. We will release the curated training dataset, VidDub-Bench, fixed paired- and cross-audio evaluation manifests, preprocessing outputs, and unified evaluation code. Across three training seeds, masking out conflicting source-mouth reconstruction improves cross-audio Sync-C by 0.833; the final two-step model combines strong lip synchronization with superior visual quality, identity preservation, and visual speech recognition across four benchmarks.

AI.brief_summary: 论文研究替换语音条件下的视频配音口型生成，提出「替换感知」的跨音频监督（屏蔽与目标语音冲突的源嘴部重建损失），并通过匹配轨迹回归与分布匹配蒸馏把全上下文扩散编辑器压缩到两步去噪。
AI.relevance_reason: 其把多步扩散轨迹蒸馏为极少步数、以及在监督中屏蔽冲突重建目标的做法，可能为 latent 推理中的迭代状态压缩与监督归因提供可供核查的线索；但任务本身属视频编辑生成，与 VLM 推理无直接联系。
